dimensions.name: Money Path Honesty
dimensions.pass_criteria: The release states exactly what moves real money and what is sandbox, test, or simulated, and claims nothing beyond that.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The release implies live payment, settlement, or provider capability that the package does not deliver end to end.

dimensions.name: Payment Data and Failure Coverage
dimensions.pass_criteria: Answers cover how card and personal data are handled, what the payer and merchant see on decline or failure, and how refunds and disputes work.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Data handling, failure behavior, or refunds and disputes are missing or answered vaguely.

dimensions.name: Compliance and Authority
dimensions.pass_criteria: PCI scope, PII and retention, required processor agreements, and which party (acquirer, merchant, partner, staff) holds each authority are answered or raised as owned open items.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Compliance obligations or party authority are assumed, skipped, or stated as fact without evidence.

dimensions.name: Fail-Closed Money Operations
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every money operation is idempotent and has no success state without provider confirmation; created and charged are distinct.
dimensions.fail_criteria: A requirement allows success, a status change, or a success message before provider confirmation, or a money operation can run twice.

dimensions.name: Slice Validation
dimensions.pass_criteria: Each slice names its schema or migration change, a validation command, a stop condition, and a demo-honesty check run as the press-release persona.
dimensions.fail_criteria: A slice has no validation command, no stop condition, or no persona-level check.

dimensions.name: Money Operations Readiness
dimensions.pass_criteria: Audit logging, rollback for each money operation, fail-closed secrets, and labelled sandbox surfaces are confirmed or explicitly deferred with an owner.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Logging, rollback, secret handling, or sandbox labelling is missing without an owned deferral.
